## Problem or user need

Who needs this, and what task is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful improvement and an example of how it would work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe an observable result that would make this complete.

## Engineering impact

If this affects calculations, geometry, units, CRS, or exports, identify the affected behavior and authoritative references or verification examples. Otherwise, write "None."

## Supporting material

Optional context or minimal, non-sensitive examples.
